showcase.zh: 任取框不开出假设，它管的是一个变量：框里的变量必须是新的，不能出现在还开着的假设里；光看说明，容易把它当成又一个假设框
showcase.en: the for-any box opens no assumption but a variable, which must be new: it may not occur in any hypothesis still open; from its description alone it is easy to take it for another assumption box

hint.zh: 框里要证的，是把 x 换成 a 的那句话。
hint.en: Inside the box, prove the sentence with a in place of x.

hint.zh: 框里随便取一样东西，叫它 a，证出「a是人 → a是人」；它对随便哪一样都成立，框外就是「对所有 x」。
hint.en: Inside the box take any thing, call it a, and prove “a is human → a is human”; holding for any one at all, outside it is “for all x”.

t.zh: <level-ref to="m-counter"></level-ref>里，一个世界就说明了推不出。要说一句话在所有世界里都成立，世界却检查不完：只能回到证明板上，靠规则。
t.en: In <level-ref to="m-counter"></level-ref>, one world showed that something does not follow. To show a sentence holds in every world, the worlds cannot all be checked: it is back to the proof board and its rules.

t.zh: 新元件任取框在框内取一个任意对象，并在元件上为它起名，例如 a。框内证出关于 a 的命题，框外便得到对所有对象成立的命题。a 不能出现在未解除的假设中。从这里起，对象用 a、b、c 命名，x、y、z 留给量词使用。
t.en: The new for-any box takes an arbitrary object inside the box and names it on the part, for example a. A statement proved about a inside becomes a statement about every object outside. a must not appear in any open assumption. From here on, objects are named a, b or c, while x, y and z are reserved for quantifiers.

after.zh: 「任取一个 a，……，所以对所有 x 成立」：数学证明里最常见的这句话，说的就是这个框。
after.en: “Take any a …, so it holds for all x”: the commonest phrase in mathematical proofs means just this box.
